prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity native Android TV HOME SCREEN design preview, a straight-on 16:9 1920x1080 screenshot filling the entire image. No television bezel, no room, no perspective, no marketing poster. The product is a custom lightweight launcher provisionally named Luma: combine the restrained efficient native app tiles of Rivi, the tasteful depth and subtle glass panels of PLUI, and the useful content recommendations of stock Google TV. This must be a beautiful practical D-pad interface at couch viewing distance. Keep typography crisp, restrained and large enough, clean contemporary humanist sans. Colors: near-black olive charcoal #111713, warm off-white #F4F1E9, subtle muted sage #9FAF9C. Static translucent dark panels with very restrained thin edges, no neon glow, no flashy backgrounds or busy widgets. Selected control has one thin warm ivory rounded focus outline, all other controls remain calm. Only one selected control. Comfortable 5% screen-safe margins. Show real app names in accurate branded rectangular tiles: Netflix, Prime Video, YouTube, Disney+, Apple TV, Max. Use these same fictional sample shows with excellent cinematic poster photography in all previews: Northbound (lonely red train in alpine forest at blue hour), Night Shift (woman investigator in rainy city), Wild Coast (dramatic sunlit ocean cliffs), Orbit (astronaut against planet horizon). These are fictional examples, not the user's viewing history. Include the exact small footer text 'Example shows · Design preview'. Show a clock '8:42 PM' and simple native search/settings line icons, no FPS numbers or performance claims. Render only the actual interface, no explanation text, option letters, design notes, or headings above the screen. Structure and exact labels for this variant follow. Variant BALANCED. Use top navigation rather than a left rail. Luma at top left, a short horizontal navigation 'Home  Shows  Apps  Inputs' with Home indicated by an understated ivory pill, clock and simple search/settings icons on right. Beneath, split the upper content into a broad feature on the LEFT (about 65% width) and a narrower stacked 'Up next' column on RIGHT (35%). Left feature has a static cinematic image of Northbound train, dim readability shade, title 'Northbound', subtitle 'Episode 4 · 26 min left' and the sole focused 'Resume' control; feature height about 330px. Right column has two horizontal compact show items with small poster thumbnails and readable info for Night Shift and Wild Coast. Beneath that split feature, put 'Your apps' with six compact branded app tiles in one row. The bottom third has 'Suggestions for you' with four landscape show cards in one row; crisp show labels and provider names. Use glass-like dark panels sparingly as the PLUI influence, clear stock-TV information hierarchy, Rivi's crisp app tile simplicity. Fit all visible content comfortably inside 1920x1080 with margins. No real-time blur visual extravagance, no live widgets, no advertising banners.
